# Сonfig

## Type
config

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `environment` | `development` | Current runtime environment |
| `log_level` | `info` | Minimum level for log output |
| `max_retries` | `3` | Number of retry attempts on failure |
| `vata` | `42` | Test prop for dummy specs |
| `eth_source_dataset` | `bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum` | Public BigQuery source for Ethereum raw data |
| `eth_default_start_block` | `0` | Default lower bound for incremental block-range loads |
